title: Empirical Fourier estimate as an expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $m$ be a positive natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, let the sample consist of $m$ points of the binary cube of dimension $n$, and let $U$ be a set of coordinates. The empirical average of $f$ times the sign monomial indexed by $U$ over the encoded sample equals the expectation of that same function under the density obtained by pushing forward the uniform distribution on the sample points.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
the sample is a map from $m$ indices to the binary cube
$U$ is a finite set of coordinates
